li.a: Report every redundant "this", without allowing adjacent statements

subsection.name: Description
subsection.div: Checks that references to instance variables and methods of the current object avoid unnecessary use of this, unless it is required to resolve ambiguity with a shadowed field.
subsection.p: By default, a redundant this is tolerated when the same statement, or the statement immediately before or after it, contains a this that is required to resolve a shadowed field. This keeps groups of assignments consistent, for example constructor bodies where only some parameters shadow fields. Set allowAdjacentToRequiredThis to false to report every redundant this.

tr.td: Allow redundant "this" when the same statement, or the statement immediately before or after it, contains a required "this".
Check whether to check redundant "this" with method call.
